shadows.name: light-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation in light mode. Extremely diffuse — structural, not decorative.

shadows.name: light-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover in light mode, paired with translateY(-1px). Confirms the element is interactive.

shadows.name: dark-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation in dark mode. High opacity required for the dark canvas to read depth.

shadows.name: dark-card
shadows.purpose: Panel and activity card shadow in dark mode. More contained than ambient.

shadows.name: accent-glow-light
shadows.purpose: Soft colored bloom on primary buttons in light mode. Not a halo — a suggestion.

shadows.name: accent-glow-light-hover
shadows.purpose: Intensified accent glow on primary button hover in light mode.

shadows.name: accent-glow-dark
shadows.purpose: Soft colored bloom on primary buttons in dark mode.

shadows.name: accent-glow-dark-hover
shadows.purpose: Intensified accent glow on primary button hover in dark mode.

shadows.name: semantic-glow-positive
shadows.purpose: Applied to the dynamic returns card when PnL is positive. The surface responds to the data.

shadows.name: semantic-glow-negative
shadows.purpose: Applied to the dynamic returns card when PnL is negative.

motion.name: instant
motion.purpose: Currency toggle, filter pills. Fastest interactive feedback.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Default for buttons and interactive controls.

motion.name: theme
motion.purpose: Theme toggle: background and text color crossfade.

motion.name: tick-flash
motion.purpose: Heatmap price tick background flash. Disappears completely — no residual color.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Live market status dot. Fades between opacity 1 and 0.4.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile breakpoint — layout switches from fixed-viewport to scrollable.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Backdrop-filter disabled on glass cards above this breakpoint to prevent mobile smear artifacts.

breakpoints.name: max-content
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum content width on dashboard and header.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Cobalt gradient, pill radius, glow shadow. Feels like a commit.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg> Refresh</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0058be 0%, #2170e4 100%); border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.12); transition: all 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.12), 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) inset; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; filter: none; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: 34x34 icon-only button. Theme toggle, utility actions. Recedes until needed.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" title="Toggle theme"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f2f4f6; color: #424754; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eceef0; color: #191c1e; }

components.name: Currency Toggle
components.description: Pill container with active inner chip. GBP/USD toggle. Active state matches primary button.
components.css: .ds-currency-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: #f2f4f6; border-radius: 99px; padding: 2px; } .ds-currency-btn { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: transparent; color: #424754; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.13s ease-out, color 0.13s ease-out; } .ds-currency-btn:hover { background: #eceef0; color: #191c1e; } .ds-currency-btn--active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0058be 0%, #2170e4 100%); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.12); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Category selector for timerange, sector, allocation filters. Decision element — not decoration.
components.css: .ds-filter-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-filter-pill { padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; background: #ffffff; color: #424754; border: 1px solid #c2c6d6; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.13s ease-out; } .ds-filter-pill:hover { border-color: #727785; color: #191c1e; background: #f2f4f6; } .ds-filter-pill--active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0058be 0%, #2170e4 100%); color: #ffffff; border-color: #0058be; }

components.css: .ds-s-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c2c6d6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px 24px 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0px 12px 32px rgba(25, 28, 30, 0.06); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-s-card:hover { box-shadow: 0px 16px 40px rgba(25, 28, 30, 0.10); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-s-card--blue { border-left: 3px solid #0058be; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 55%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.06)); } .ds-s-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-s-card-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.10); color: #2170e4; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-s-card-label { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #727785; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-s-card-value { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #191c1e; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-s-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid #c2c6d6; } .ds-s-card-pct { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-s-card-pct.pos { color: #10b981; } .ds-s-card-pct.neg { color: #9c3c3e; } .ds-s-card-sub { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #727785; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Panel Badge
components.description: Small label badge. Used on panel headers to indicate data freshness, count, or category.
components.css: .ds-panel-badge { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.12); color: #0058be; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 88, 190, 0.12); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 99px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Live Status Dot
components.description: Indicates live market data. Green + pulse when open; muted when closed. Never decorative.
components.css: @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } } .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #424754; background: #f2f4f6; border: 1px solid #c2c6d6; border-radius: 99px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #727785; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-badge--live .ds-status-dot { background: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 5px #10b981; animation: ds-pulse 2s infinite; } .ds-status-badge--live { color: #424754; }

narrative.overview:
Dense, precise, data-forward. This is the interface of someone who acts on information rather than admires it. Every element earns its place not by aesthetic appeal but by functional necessity: the font choices, the color decisions, the shadow vocabulary are all calibrated to one end — getting you to the right number, in the right context, in the fewest possible eye movements.

The system runs two fully equal themes. Light mode is the clean daytime session — a cool worksheet white backdrop where data sits against pure paper, numbers rendered in near-black ink. Dark mode is the late-session, second-screen presence — a deep midnight navy constellation lit by cobalt signal blues, where financial values glow like readouts on a console. Neither is a courtesy toggle; both are first-class.

This system refuses the gamification vocabulary of consumer finance apps. No rainbow gradients, no celebration confetti, no 'you're up 3% today' copy. Gains and losses are facts, not emotions. The interface has no opinion about your portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-role typography: Inter for UI structure, JetBrains Mono strictly for financial values and tabular data
Two equal themes: cool worksheet light and deep-navy dark, each independently tuned
Restrained color strategy with one execution accent (cobalt) and three semantic signal colors
Precise diffuse shadows in light; deep contrast shadows in dark
Controls feel like switches on a panel, not decorative affordances

rules.name: The Cobalt Only Rule
rules.body: One execution accent, used precisely. Cobalt appears on the primary CTA, active toggle pills, active nav items, and accent glows only.

rules.name: The Semantic Signals Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and amber are reserved for financial signal only. Never use them for decoration or non-financial categorization.

rules.name: The Mono Gate Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for financial values and code. Never use it for labels, headings, or prose. Never use Inter for financial values.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only to communicate structural depth or interactive state. Never for decoration.

rules.name: The Theme-Calibrated Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use light-mode shadow values in dark mode or vice versa. Each is tuned for its surface.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for financial values, percentages, ticker symbols, and tabular numbers.
Do apply the two-step hover pattern on cards: translateY(-1px) + deeper shadow.
Do design and test both light and dark themes as first-class experiences.
Do reserve semantic colors for financial signal only.
Do keep cobalt to interactive affordances: buttons, active states, nav indicators.
Do use pill radius (99px) on primary CTAs and toggle pill containers.
Do accompany portfolio identity left borders with their diagonal gradient tint.
donts: Don't add rainbow gradients, neon glows, confetti, or gamification elements.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient fill).
Don't generalize the left-border accent strip to callouts, alerts, or emphasis contexts.
Don't use semantic signal colors for non-financial categorization or decoration.
Don't apply backdrop-filter glass in light mode.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for labels, headings, or prose.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing anywhere in the system.
Don't import the same shadow value into both themes.
Don't design this to resemble a retail crypto app, consumer fintech, or gamified trading platform.
